result:
No failures, only pre-existing warnings about unrelated missing test files.

The bug was in `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`: `toArray()` built the serialized post without the `excerpt` field, even though `PostResourceData` declared it as required. This meant every response through `PostResource` (post list, post show, edit form) omitted the excerpt, while the raw `excerpt` column stayed intact in the database — which is why search (querying the DB column directly) still worked. I added `excerpt: post.excerpt as string` back into the returned object, matching the pattern of the other fields. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, and `bunx guren check` all pass.
